title: Patch: a Ctrl/Cmd+K command menu on the menu screens
thread:
**Issue #2118 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2118: Patch: a Ctrl/Cmd+K command menu on the menu screens
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of #2036. This is a patch of its own: it goes live when it merges and builds on `main` beside the tracker's other parts.

## What

Ctrl+K (⌘K on Apple devices) opens a command menu on every menu screen.

- **Entries:**
  - every menu route the player can open, reached through `navigate()` so R1754000's leave guard still holds a move;
  - the common actions: new deck, practice, play;
  - a card search by name, over the shipped catalog only (`almanacShelf`, R1420: no unshipped card), whose result opens that card's inspect detail.
- **Filtering.** Typing filters the entries by a case-insensitive match on their words in the player's locale (`t()`).
- **Keys.** Arrow keys move the selection, Enter runs it, and Escape or a click outside closes the menu.
- **Focus.** The menu is a modal dialog. Focus moves to its input on open, Tab stays inside it, and focus returns to where it was on close.
- **Not on the board.** The menu is not mounted on any board route (match, practice game, hotseat, duos, watch, replay), so it never takes keys from a game.
- **Typing elsewhere.** Ctrl/Cmd+K opens it even from a text field, but a plain letter typed into another field never does.
- **Touch.** It needs a keyboard, so there is no touch entry point.

## Done when

vitest checks that:
- Ctrl+K and Meta+K open the menu on a menu screen, and nothing opens on a board route;
- Enter on a route entry calls `navigate()`, and the leave guard still holds it;
- the card search lists no unshipped card, and its result opens the inspect detail;
- Escape closes the menu and returns focus;
- Tab stays inside the menu.

## Ground rules (from #2036)

- Read `apps/web/README.md` before changing the client. CLAUDE.md rule 7: nothing here predicts, enforces or reveals game state.
- Every number is a named constant (rule 9).
- Every animation and gesture follows Reduce motion: the media query, and `data-motion="reduced"` from the settings panel.
- If SPEC §10 doesn't already decide a behaviour, add a ruling note numbered from this issue's own block (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers), with its proving test named after it.
- Gates: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`.
- The PR closes this issue, says `Part of #2036`, and carries one `## Player note` line.
```
